page_description_chirho: Finish setting up the Perffection account you were invited to.
intro_chirho: Enter the sign-in name and the setup code from your invitation email, and choose your own password. Then you sign in with it.
principal_help_chirho: Copy the complete sign-in name from your invitation, including user/ at the beginning. It is not your email address.
code_help_chirho: Type the code from your invitation email. It works once, and it expires. Nobody from Perffection will ever ask you for it.
new_password_help_chirho: Use at least {min_characters_chirho} characters. A short sentence you will remember works well. Your setup code is only used once your password is accepted.
confirm_password_help_chirho: The same password once more, so a typing slip cannot lock you out.
help_body_chirho: A setup code works only once, and only until it expires. If yours does not work, reply to your invitation email and we will send you a new one.
too_weak_body_chirho: Nothing was changed, and your setup code still works. Use at least {min_characters_chirho} characters.
mismatch_heading_chirho: The two passwords did not match.
mismatch_body_chirho: Nothing was changed, and your setup code still works. Type the same password in both boxes.
refused_heading_chirho: That sign-in name and code did not work.
refused_body_chirho: Check both against your invitation email. A code works once and expires; if yours has, reply to your invitation and we will send a new one.
rate_limited_body_chirho: Please wait about {wait_minutes_chirho} minutes, then try again.
request_invalid_heading_chirho: Something in the form was missing.
request_invalid_body_chirho: Please fill in every field, then try again.
not_set_body_chirho: Something went wrong on our side before your new password was saved. Your setup code still works, so please try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, reply to your invitation email.
failed_heading_chirho: Your password may already be set.
failed_body_chirho: Something went wrong just after your password was saved. Try signing in with your new password first. If that does not work, reply to your invitation email.
